rows.contract: Run the real widget code and Qt model with approved SDK, no runtime Vulkan, GL or legacy Metal dependencies.
rows.native_mapping: Compile real native and off configurations and use both actual empty discovery and a deterministic supported/unsupported Cocoa-config fixture.
rows.expected_result: UIC/MOC, native model visibility, selected ordinal, settings application and test regressions pass.
rows.actual_result: Real Qt offscreen UI, no-device discovery, deterministic available/unavailable device variants, global and per-game Spatial, independent guest filtering, native and feature-off compile plus PICA 48/801 and CTest 64 passes.

rows.contract: Display real hardware capability and ensure the MetalFX presentation option takes effect through native renderer.
rows.native_mapping: With an exposed Apple Silicon GPU, select real adapters and toggle Spatial while changing native output size. Verify capability labels and actual output path.
rows.expected_result: Full hardware, presentation, global/per-game save and renderer integration sweep.
rows.actual_result: Exact remaining verification is recorded in progress.json.

rows.contract: An enabled preference can be turned off after a switch to a device without native Spatial.
rows.native_mapping: Define the Phase 088 update method and shared check state, allow enabled preference opt-out as a state transition and prevent re-enabling with unsupported hardware.
rows.expected_result: Qt fixture reproduces then passes supported to unsupported to opt-out and supported again, with global/per-game independence and no filter changes.
rows.actual_result: Reproduced Qt assertion before fix. Native/off compile, link, exact unsupported-device opt-out fixture, PICA and CTest retested.

rows.contract: The generated Designer form owns one Metal entry and one Spatial checkbox with stable Qt API ordinals.
rows.native_mapping: Consume generated fields directly and keep disabled builds free of the Metal API choice. Reapply translated names at the model’s per-game offset.
rows.expected_result: Actual duplicate-control failure then success for UIC field identity, per-game retranslation and opt-out.
rows.actual_result: Reproduced duplicate UI identity with new UIC. Native/off compile, actual Qt linkage, Designer, per-game and independent settings tests passed.
